data.name: 2B
data.backstory: A taciturn blade of silent resolve. "Mission briefing required."
data.harmony_cubes_info: After the introduction of Vigor Cube (Increased Max HP), this cube is the best for her. Put it if you plan to invest in 2B.

data.name: A2
data.backstory: A hate-filled vortex with a painful past. "Objective: Destroy Machine Lifeforms."
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience is preferred if no Max Ammo OL. Otherwise, just use your highest-level cube for more attack and elemental damage bonuses. Adjutant might actually be the best in slot but more testing needs to be done.

data.name: Ade
data.backstory: Ade does her utmost to provide the best service to guests of Maid For You, i.e, the "Masters". All experiences are tailored to each customer's preferences.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Both Bastion and Resilience would serve her well for PvE purposes for more reliable Reset Time (Skill 2) stacking. Bastion > Resilience for Ade.

data.name: Admi
data.backstory: A Nikke from Triangle. Her time in the army has given her a maturity far beyond her years. Kittens are her favorite.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Admi doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an SR wielder.

data.name: Alice
data.backstory: An endearing individual who often indulges in fantasy with a somewhat unique worldview. She's a member of Unlimited, and spends her days looking for Rabbity.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion and Resilience provide quite the same "effective" ammo increased, so you just need to put the highest level cube on her. After overload, when you have enough ammo OL, she prefers bastion over resilience.

data.name: Alice: Wonderland Bunny
data.backstory: By sheer coincidence, Alice is wearing a bunny costume. Ecstatic, she proceeds to spend her time meeting various rabbit-related characters at Coin Rush.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion theoretically has slightly more uptime than Resilience because of reload animation delay (built-in on all characters), but Resilience will also do just fine.

data.name: Anchor
data.backstory: Her love for marine life and the sea spurred her to join the Navy. Has top-tier surveillance skills, loves fishing but is quirky and always excoriated by Helm.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Any taunt tank would enjoy more HP. And Resilience works with any last bullet Nikke.

data.name: Anchor: Innocent Maid
data.backstory:
A girl who seems like she is not entirely of this world. 

She has donned a swimsuit while working as a maid, and is the exemplification of all romantic ideals.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For true “infinite ammo”, you will need Resilience 7+ and Mast:RM or Crown.

data.name: Anis
data.backstory: A girl that knows exactly how to survive in this forlorn world. Somewhere in between somber Rapi and off-the-wall Neon, she is fond of telling jokes to lighten the mood whenever things get too tense.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Anis's role is Burst Gen Battery, and Quantum on her is actually very important. It allows you to burst faster than enemy, leading to easier win in PVP. She's one of the Holy Trinity worth putting Quantum cube on.

data.name: Anis: Sparkling Summer
data.backstory: Summer vacation is finally here! Unable to contain her excitement, Anis puts on a meticulously chosen swimsuit and heads for the beach!
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience is the best cube you can use on Summer Anis.

data.name: Anne: Miracle Fairy
data.backstory: Anne after being reborn as a winter spirit upon receiving some gifts from Rupee. Rupee's infectious positive energy has made her more cheerful and optimistic than ever before.
data.harmony_cubes_info: XAnee cube of choice depends on how you use her - if you can make sure she will stay above 90% HP for her S2 to trigger, use Adjutant Cube on her. Otherwise, go with the generic Resilience or Wingman Cubes.

data.name: Arcana
data.backstory:
She is an extrovert through and through, with a friendly personality that makes her able to get along with just about anyone. 

She also runs a small tarot shop as a side business. Her proclivity for eccentricity is channeled into her unique interpretations of tarot cards, which she then uses to tease others (mostly the Commander). Her readings tend to be surprisingly accurate, so her shop was quite successful.
data.harmony_cubes_info: As always, Resilience or Bastion in PvE for more rockets shot, which help with burst generation. Tempering may situationally be useful in healerless runs. Quantum may be useful for extra burst gen (we have noticed that this extra squeeze can be extremely helpful).

data.name: Aria
data.backstory: An opera singer from Prima Donna, where she plays the lead in every performance she's a part of. Her singing consistently garners standing ovations, making her a living legend in the world of opera.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Despite being an MG user, Aria wants to empty her mag as fast as possible, so the usual MG Cubes aren't good for her. That's why Resilience Cube with the reload speed boost is what works on her best.

data.name: Asuka Shikinami Langley
data.harmony_cubes_info: With Reload Speed buffers, opt for Resilience. Without, use Bastion (Lv 7+ highly recommended).

data.name: Asuka Shikinami Langley: Wille
data.harmony_cubes_info: Destruction is the best option, followed by Bastion. Asuka 2.0 can hit parts too and gain bonus damage from them. When the boss has strong parts, the Destruction Cube will be the best for every character. Otherwise, select Bastion cube for this unit.

data.name: Bay
data.backstory: Ark's Cheerleading Squad — Captain of Rewind. Suffers from scopophobia, but becomes very enthusiastic when it comes to cheering someone on.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Since Bay is a Defender with damage share effect, the only cube for her will be Vigor - which increases her Max HP, allowing her to soak even more damage.

data.name: Bay (Treasure)
data.backstory: Ark's Cheerleading Squad — Captain of Rewind. Suffers from scopophobia, but becomes very enthusiastic when it comes to cheering someone on.

data.name: Belorta
data.backstory: The leader of the Carronades who is adorable and cuddly. She possesses above-average intelligence and has a soft spot for pulling pranks.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube will allow Belorta to reach Full Charge faster and keep the enemies debuffed with her S2. Bastion Cube allows her to shoot for longer before reloading, while Resilience is a general shooting uptime increase.

data.name: Biscuit
data.backstory: A Nikke belonging to Happy Zoo, the Ark's animal management squad. Due to her ability to communicate with animals, her responsibilities consist of rescuing stray and abused animals.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For PVE, Resilience Cube are the best on Biscuit because she tends to go with Privaty-Sanis team. For PVP, you really want the Adjutant Cube as there you race to use your Bursts before the enemy. Or it can even be a Vigor to stay alive from Scarlet's burst.

data.name: Blanc
data.backstory: It is said that any gambler who sees both twin sisters in Coin Rush will hit the jackpot. To bring good luck, she always forces her sister to join her.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Vigor cube helps her healing ability. Both Ammo Refill and Reload Speed help her with Skill 1 uptime.

data.name: Bready
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience always when pairing with Maids as the relationship between Reload Speed and overall uptime is exponential.

data.name: Brid
data.backstory: An AZX driver from Infinity Ral, a workaholic and a perfectionist. She is widely considered to be the best driver in the Ark.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.

data.name: Centi
data.backstory: An artisan with incredible strength who puts her heart into everything she does, never failing to get the job done at Mighty Tools. As Liter's first apprentice, she has great respect for her mentor. She always listens to what Liter says, and studies her techniques in earnest.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Centi's position in both PVE and PVP is Burst Gen Battery (in PVE she has a very good shield too). Hence allowing her to shoot as much as you can first round matters the most in PVE. For PVP, she's one of the Holy Trinity that requires Quantum cube to push your Burst timing faster.

data.name: Cinderella
data.harmony_cubes_info: With Reload Speed buffers in your team, opt for Resilience Cube. Without them, use Bastion (Lv 7+ highly recommended). Bastion is highly effective on Cinderella since you want her to never reload and keep shooting since if she reloads, she also needs to charge up her shot again, and hence it is a big waste of time.

data.name: Clay
data.backstory: A new member of the cheerleading team, Rewind Squad. She admires and idolizes Bay. Despite being rhythmically challenged, her infectious energy allows her to captivate audiences like no one else can.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Depends. Without Max Ammo OL, Resilience is better than Bastion because that will enable her to land 180 shots within 10s during Full Burst (for 3 stacks of S1), but there is barely any leeway. Bastion would only work if she never reloads during Full Burst at all, which requires Max Ammo and preemptive reloading.

data.name: Cocoa
data.backstory: The pampered youngest member and the Maid Leader of Maid For You. She works so hard to complete her own duties professionally.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube is the clear winner for Cocoa as it will let her stack the S2 buff on herself faster, but Resiliance Cube with the Reload Speed boost also works well on her.

data.name: Crow
data.backstory: The leader of Exotic, from the Outer Rim. There is a whiff of madness underneath her calm exterior, like a ticking time bomb that could go off at any moment.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Last bullet abusing SMG characters really just care about reload speed.

data.name: Crown
data.backstory: A Pilgrim from the White Knight squad. She identifies herself as a king and is currently recruiting subjects for her kingdom. She strives toward the goal of fulfilling her subjects' wishes.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Since she is an MG, Bastion would always be good, but don't be fooled! Crown also grants herself Reload Speed, so Resilience is actually very strong on her due to the lack of winding up. Always use Resilience cube on Crown!

data.name: Crust
data.harmony_cubes_info: Most SRs/RLs, especially without Max Ammo OL, are more comfortable to use with Resilience. Bastion is an alternative.

data.name: D
data.backstory: The leader of Perilous Siege. Not a single wicked soul will escape her grasp, so long she believes their death will be of benefit to the world. Has a tendency to play up her persona when carrying out a mission.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: D: Killer Wife
data.harmony_cubes_info: With a minimum of one Max Ammo line, Resilience is best in helping make S2 triggers more uniform. Bastion can be used as an alternative if slots are full or if you have tons of Max Ammo. With no Max Ammo lines, however, you can select Wingman (min. level 7). Not 7 yet? Use Resilience for now.

data.name: Delta
data.backstory: The leader of the Scouts who is an exemplary soldier. Her military professionalism is reflected in the tactical competency of her squad.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube will allow her to reach Full Charge faster while Resilience Cube just offers generic uptime on shooting.

data.name: Delta: Ninja Thief
data.backstory: To embody the stealthy and silent nature of a Phantom Thief, she decides to become a Ninja Thief.

data.name: Diesel
data.backstory: The leader of Infinity Rail who has a heart of gold. She always carries a bag of strawberry candy and helps guide lost passengers to their seats.
data.harmony_cubes_info: MG goes brrr. Bastion Cube will allow her to shoot for longer, but if you don't have it upgraded, Resilience or Wingman Cubes are a better choice.

data.name: Diesel (Treasure)
data.backstory: The leader of Infinity Rail who has a heart of gold. She always carries a bag of strawberry candy and helps guide lost passengers to their seats.
data.harmony_cubes_info: MGs love the bastion cube! If you haven't reached 700+ Ammo, slap Bastion on her. But, depending on your Favorite Item Progression and Ammo lines (700+ Ammo in Phase 1/2), she will never reload so you can slap Vigor cube on her (Max HP up) to make her survive better during taunting.

data.name: Dolla
data.backstory: A true enterprising spirit. Rumor has it that she's a VIP of a large illegal website. She is the most rational member of Talentum.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Dolla doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an SR wielder.

data.name: Dorothy
data.harmony_cubes_info: There's no other choice for Dorothy besides the Resilience Cube. You want to empty the magazine as fast as possible, so avoid Wingman.

data.name: Dorothy: Serendipity
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion Lv. 7+ is a mandatory cube, although in some cases you can make a compromise and use Pierce/Destruction if the end damage is higher. However, this will impact her uptime and rotation, potentially requiring you to get an extra Max Ammo line to compensate. Note that Destruction cube has no use in PvP.

data.name: Drake
data.backstory: A hero who yearns to be a villain. As a part of Matis, she has the special ability to detect radio waves with her body.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Drake (Treasure)
data.backstory: A hero who yearns to be a villain. As a part of Matis, she has the special ability to detect radio waves with her body.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion generally pairs best with Shotgun units due to synergy with Tove, Noir, and Bunny Alice (if applicable). It also helps ensure they are able to shoot an entire Full Burst. A close-second alternative and sometimes not even inferior depending on team investments and composition. Might be better if your Resilience has a significantly higher level compared to Bastion.

data.name: Ein
data.harmony_cubes_info: With Reload Speed team, Resilience is the best. Otherwise, Bastion is the best if you have at least 1× Max Ammo, else use Resilience for more comfortable magazine handling.

data.name: Elegg
data.backstory:
A Nikke from the Electric Shock squad.
She's an expert in power sources of electronics, and her hobby is installing the classic FPS game, BOOM, on every device that has a screen.

data.name: Emilia
data.backstory: A half elf girl with silver hair, and light purple eyes.
data.harmony_cubes_info:
In PvE, the primary cubes are always Bastion and Resilience because they provide the highest uptime bonus. Since Emilia also scales with Max Ammo, you can also consider Wingman if highly leveled, which will make her S1 more effective.

In PvP, you can additionally consider Vigor for increased survival, Adjutant if that helps with reaching the breakpoint informed in Gear Investments section, or Quantum for bonus burst gen.

data.name: Emma
data.backstory: Something of a sister figure for Absolute, who enjoys caring for others. Yet, there are times when she lets her guard down.
data.harmony_cubes_info: It's very hard to trigger Emma's S1 in PVE, because it requires her to be hit, hence you may want to use Bastion there. But for PVP, especially in early stage when everyone lack core characters for PVP, Vigor Emma will make their life suffer even more with her near invincible regen.

data.name: Emma: Tactical Upgrade
data.backstory:
Her outfit is infused with a special liquid that acts as an electronics jammer, which she can disperse into the air at will.
This substance can interfere with communications or cause malfunctions in mechanical devices.

Additionally, anything that comes into contact with the airborne particles is relayed back to Emma, effectively allowing her to use these particles as a wide-area detection ability.

data.name: Epinel
data.backstory: A member of Nepenthe who is a master at pulling off skateboarding tricks. She is revered among teenagers because of her distinctly cool and chic demeanor.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Ether
data.backstory: A mad scientist who believes that science is the domain of humankind. She can often be seen carrying out all manner of experiments and overseeing the lives of her fellow M.M.R. members.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Eunhwa
data.backstory: The leader of Absolute who evokes an air of both arrogance and composure. Her perfectionism pushed Absolute up to the pinnacle of success.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube helps her with the last bullet mechanic.

data.name: Eunhwa: Tactical Upgrade
data.backstory:
Once haunted and held back by her past, she has now cast off all her emotional burdens and hesitation, reaching a new echelon, both physically and mentally.

The scarf around her neck is equipped with a camouflage function, allowing her to stay better hidden while sniping and focus more precisely on her shots.

data.name: Exia
data.backstory: A hacking wunderkind from Protocol. No one can hold a candle to her when it comes to video games.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube helps her with the last bullet mechanic.

data.name: Exia (Treasure)
data.backstory: A hacking wunderkind from Protocol. No one can hold a candle to her when it comes to video games.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube should be the best option for Exia. Adjutant cube can be a viable replacement if one does not have enough slots for Resilience cube.

data.name: Flora
data.harmony_cubes_info: In Reload Speed comp, use Resilience. Otherwise, use Bastion. You can use Vigor and Healing Cube(s) to boost her healing.

data.name: Flora (Treasure)
data.backstory: A Nikke from the Botanic Garden Squad who's responsible for tending to the plants in the Ark's garden, especially flowers. She expresses her affection in her own way, such as naming and talking to the flowers.

data.name: Folkwang
data.backstory: An athlete from Nepenthe. She is sweating all the time due to having no resistance to heat, but she is full of vigor.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.

data.name: Frima (Treasure)
data.backstory: The leader of Cafe Sweety, who sells cream coffee. Her inherent laziness actually leads her to discover the most efficient ways to get things done.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Charge Speed increase helps with both S1 and S2.

data.name: Grave
data.harmony_cubes_info: No particular cube. Use your highest-level available cube, preferably Bastion, to cover up accidental mistakes in battle.

data.name: Guillotine
data.backstory: A Nikke from Extrinsic who is always off in her own world. She believes that it is her destiny to lead a solitary life. Half-obscured with an eye patch, who knows where she draws her gaze?
data.harmony_cubes_info: Before OL, when you can't access Ammo Increased, a Resilience Cube with Privaty/Summer Anis will actually help her more than Bastion, but it requires you manually playing her (force reload during buff). Post OL, you can roll a lot of ammo on her, thus reduce the depending on Reload comp. Still, Resilience + Privaty are a good combo in Elysion tower.

data.name: Guillotine: Winter Slayer
data.backstory: Guillotine has entered a simulation which is a manifestation of her own mental world. In this world, Guillotine embarks on a heroic adventure to defeat the White Ice Dragon.
data.harmony_cubes_info: XGuillo best uses Bastion outside Reload Speed comps, but when there is a Reload Speed buffer in the team, Resilience is the most optimal choice.

data.name: Guilty
data.backstory: A Nikke subordinate to the Real Kindness Squad. Possesses incredible strength. Has been detained in the Rehabilitation Center for causing severe bodily damage to over 40 Nikkes within 2 weeks.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Guilty needs to shoot a lot to increase/maintain her stacks, which makes Bastion/Resilience a much better choice on her. But when you can roll a lot of Ammo Increased and Hit Rate on her, an Assault Cube is actually not bad considering you need to put Bastion/Resilience on more meta Nikkes.

data.name: Harran
data.backstory: A charming necromancer from Inherit who relishes her role as an apex predator on the surface. She uses a large scythe and mechanical crows to fight.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Onslaught and Resilience Cube both work really well on Harran, while Wingman is trailing behind them, but still being a viable option.

data.name: Helm
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube helps her with the last bullet mechanic.

data.name: Helm (Treasure)
data.harmony_cubes_info: For PvP: Her burst gen is so huge that Quantum becomes very impactful on her. For PvE: Typical Cube for DPS. Slap it on her if you want to go DPS build.

data.name: Helm: Aquamarine
data.backstory: Feeling the summer weather and seeing the ocean has Helm feeling more chipper, as she envisions steering The Admire on the aquamarine waters.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.

data.name: Himeno
data.backstory: Member of Public Safety Devil Extermination Special Division 4. Hayakawa's senior officer and buddy.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Charge Speed increase helps with S1 uptime.

data.name: Isabel
data.backstory: An aerial partner with a twisted mind. She will track her target to the ends of the earth, regardless of whether they're friend or foe. It's because of her that Inherit is a force to be reckoned with in the skies.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Jackal
data.backstory: A Nikke subordinate to the Exotic Squad. Crow's loyal lackey. Fully prepared to do Crow's bidding at any given moment.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Jackal is the best tank + burst battery in PVP/PVE, and Vigor will make her survive even longer. Quantum Cube should be the best on her.

data.name: Julia
data.backstory: A violinist whose life revolves around music. Belonging to Master Hand, she uses music as a way to express herself.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the best choice for anyone with the last bullet mechanism.

data.name: Julia (Treasure)
data.backstory: A violinist whose life revolves around music. Belonging to Master Hand, she uses music as a way to express herself.

data.name: K
data.backstory:
Belongs to a Nikke squad that specializes in assassination.
She harbors an intense distrust of humans, and does not see why she should have to help mankind reclaim the surface. However, she also realizes that if word of this gets out, she will be promptly discarded. She therefore grits her teeth and keeps her mouth shut.
data.harmony_cubes_info: You want her to reload fast, not shoot longer, so don’t bring anything that makes her reach the last bullet longer.

data.name: Kilo
data.backstory: A pilot from the Heavy Gram squad who operates T.A.L.O.S., a robot equipped with high-performance AI. They have a record of being in multiple squads but struggle to find a place to belong.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Vigor! Her burst scales on HP, her shield scales on HP, there's no reason you don't use Vigor (HP cube) on her.

data.name: Laplace
data.backstory: The leader of Matis, the top squad in Missilis. She more than lives up to her heroic reputation inside the Ark, which goes unquestioned.
data.harmony_cubes_info: She doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an RL wielder.

data.name: Laplace (Treasure)
data.backstory: The leader of Matis, the top squad in Missilis. She more than lives up to her heroic reputation inside the Ark, which goes unquestioned.
data.harmony_cubes_info: She doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an RL wielder.

data.name: Laplace: Ultimate Hero
data.backstory: A true hero who's been reborn using the full might of Missilis's technology. Should you ever find yourself in a crisis, you needn't worry; wherever help is needed, that's where she'll be.

data.name: Leona
data.backstory: The oldest member of the Happy Zoo. Entrusted to take care of ferocious animals such as lions and tigers. Even the most disobedient animal will obey her.
data.harmony_cubes_info: She needs to maintain her S1 stacks as long as she can, so a faster reload (Resilience) or longer shooting (Bastion) is welcome here.

data.name: Liberalio
data.harmony_cubes_info:
Most of Liberalio’s damage is skill damage. Use your highest-level cube for ELE buff if applicable. Otherwise, Resilience is preferred for better synergy with Crown + MastM, Nayuta + MastM, MastM + AnchorM, which don’t give “perfect reload speed” yet. Adjutant could be better if Reload Speed is maxed, ELE is not required, and the level is high enough compared to your Resilience/Bastion, but it’s not recommended to level & use for PvE.

In PvP, use Tempering mainly or Vigor for increased survivability pre-Burst and post-Burst. If survivability is not a concern, use your highest-level cube.

data.name: Liter
data.backstory: The leader of Mighty Tools. Contrary to her appearance, she has already lived a long life. At present, no other NIKKE can surpass her when it comes to construction.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful). Wingman is a good alternative to both.

data.name: Ludmilla
data.backstory: A Nikke from Unlimited. She lives in the bitterly cold northern lands, where she saves Nikkes who have lost their way. Any machinery she touches will...
data.harmony_cubes_info: A SMG wielder with the last bullet mechanic really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: Ludmilla: Winter Owner
data.backstory: Some Nikkes went to investigate new hot springs, and had a great time thanks to the owner - Ludmilla's hospitality.
data.harmony_cubes_info:
We recommend Bastion for starters. If you have uninvested Burst and have insufficient Max Ammo OL to back it up, Bastion will improve her uptime by up to 172% alone (S1 level 10, Bastion level 7+). You can also place her in Liter/Blanc/Noir team for effortless ammo retaining.

Once her Burst is invested and you acquire 2 Max Ammo lines, feel free to move her out and slap Resilience. This will reduce or eliminate the downtime incurred by reloading, thus increasing the total damage output over long periods. The minimum Burst level for usability is at least 5, but we recommend 6 or higher. It will feel much smoother at level 10.

data.name: Maiden
data.backstory: A Nikke from Extrinsic who dresses to impress. Underneath her mask lies a shocking secret.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Maiden: Ice Rose
data.backstory: Maiden has entered a simulation which is a manifestation of Guillotine's mental world. In the quest to defeat the White Ice Dragon, Maiden takes on the role of the party's mage.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Outside Raid, she is more likely to be deployed in the "Best Electric Bossing Comp Against Water Without CP Penalty" comp, which features Reload Speed buffers like Crown and SAnis. In this case, like usual, Resilience is always the best option because of Reload Speed stacking. In Raid, this may change depending on whether the boss is Electric-weak.

data.name: Makima
data.backstory: Member of Public Safety Devil Extermination Special Division 4. A devil hunter working directly under the Chief Cabinet Secretary.
data.harmony_cubes_info: A SMG wielder who syncs pretty well with the Reload Speed increase - as she will Taunt after emptying her mag.

data.name: Mana
data.backstory:
Mana not only oversees research into new technologies at M.M.R, but also assumes responsibility as the person in charge.

Many consider her a role model due to her excellent work skills and straightforward approach to matters.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience or Bastion would probably be her best bet in PvE for that increased normal attack uptime. Use whichever cube has a higher level. Meanwhile, in PvP, she can make use of Tempering, Healing, and Vigor cube pretty well.

data.name: Marciana
data.backstory: M.M.R. Vocational School teacher. Her belly ring is a special device which helps make informed decisions in an emergency. Has a drone as a secretary.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience. Period. This will allow her to abuse her Skill 1 way more often. Bastion and Wingman are the opposite and should be avoided. Assault can be usedfor more hitrate, but why?

data.name: Mari Makinami Illustrious
data.harmony_cubes_info: We usually recommend Resilience Cube for Sniper Rifles because the shorter reload helps with smoother quick shots for burst gen. This is more true if you don't have any Max Ammo OL. Meanwhile, Bastion Cube technically allows her to shoot more shots over 3 minutes.

data.name: Mary
data.backstory: A talented doctor who treats her patients with an unsurpassed solicitude. In Seraphim, she is known as the Angel in White. As for patients who disobey her orders, however...
data.harmony_cubes_info: A Shotgun wielder with the last bullet mechanic really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: Mary: Bay Goddess
data.backstory: To protect her friends who are risking their lives for a seaside sojourn, Mary provides them with medical assistance with her makeshift clinic.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Healing Cube is the go-to cube for her currently.

data.name: Mast
data.backstory: Mast has longed to hit the high seas ever since she first saw the swashbuckling adventures portrayed in pirate films as a child. As time drew on, however, her soul-crushing tenure at the Naval Squad slowly made her disillusioned. Even so, her vibrant personality remains untarnished, and she always brightens everyone else's day aboard the ship she serves.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Mast: Romantic Maid
data.backstory:
Mast has finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a pirate.

However, due to participating in the Unconventional Maid Competition without realizing what she was signing up for, Mast ends up working as a maid.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For true “infinite ammo”, you will need Resilience 7+ and Anchor: IM or Crown. Or, if you fancy, just slap a defensive cube on her (good idea for PvP, at least). You can even run her with any filler cube, and it’s fine. The higher the level, the better, because cube boosts base ATK stat.

data.name: Maxwell
data.backstory: A genius researcher who loves nothing more than machines and knowledge. As the brain of Matis, she is both perceptive, whip-smart, and capable of producing weapons in a flash.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Onslaught and Resilience Cube both work really well on Maxwell, while Wingman is trailing behind them, but still being a viable option.

data.name: Maxwell: Ordinary Mechanic
data.backstory: Missilis's best researcher is back and better than ever. With her enhanced firepower and even sharper intelligence, she can calculate all variables on the battlefield.

data.name: Mica
data.backstory: A Nikke from the Carronades who is extremely naive. Her sole friend Belorta is the only one she will fully trust without hesitation.
data.harmony_cubes_info: She doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an RL wielder.

data.name: Mica: Snow Buddy
data.backstory: Mica is unhappy being assigned to search for the Snowfield Hot Springs, but forged unforgettable memories with Belorta there.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Both Bastion and Resilience would serve her well for PvE purposes for more reliable stacking. In PvP, you can opt for Quantum instead (or even Vigor if she constantly dies before she can benefit from her Burst Skill).

data.name: Mihara
data.backstory: A masochist from Wardress with delicate features. For her, feeling pain is the only way to truly feel alive. She and her squadmate Yuni are practically inseparable.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the best choice for anyone with the last bullet mechanism.

data.name: Mihara: Bonding Chain
data.harmony_cubes_info:
Bastion with non-Reload Speed comps, Resilience with Reload Speed comps, and Destruction situationally if it leads to more damage according to your testing in a specific content.

In PvP, since you want her dead anyway, perhaps Vigor & Tempering aren't what you want, although they can be situationally useful when you need the slight added delay. Instead, you'd want your highest level cube to increase her base ATK stat/ELE damage.

data.name: Milk
data.backstory: A combative girl who likes to provoke others. She sells milk coffee in Cafe Sweety.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Milk doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an SR wielder.

data.name: Milk (Treasure)
data.backstory: A combative girl who likes to provoke others. She sells milk coffee in Cafe Sweety.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For PvE, you would want cubes that allow her to Full Charge more often. Resilience is your best friend. For PvP, you would want cubes that increase her survivability (Tempering or Vigor), but Adjutant is also a passable alternative for extra Charge Speed if you want to FB faster.

data.name: Miranda
data.backstory: A Nikke from the A.C.P.U. who has no lack of passion but sometimes falls short in her work performance. Despite her supposed secret of being an A.C.P.U. Inspector, everyone is all too aware of it.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion Cube will give her a higher uptime on her S1 buff while Resilience Cube will be a general improvement to her performance.

data.name: Miranda (Treasure)
data.backstory: A Nikke from the A.C.P.U. who has no lack of passion but sometimes falls short in her work performance. Despite her supposed secret of being an A.C.P.U. Inspector, everyone is all too aware of it.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For PvE content, use the cube with the highest level to increase her personal damage, but limit yourself to either of these two for higher uptime. The new Destruction cube is also fine if the boss's part is tanky. In PvP, the most ideal cubes are always the defensive ones (Tempering and Vigor), but if you don't have them, the other cubes like Resilience or Bastion are also fine.

data.name: Modernia
data.backstory: A plain and delicate girl who sold out mankind. A member of the Queen's elite squad, the Heretics.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Even when you haven't unlocked Overload, you would still want to rely on Bastion, because Mod can access Hit Rate whenever you are in Full Burst. You will have down time for ATK buff, but the gain from Bastion always makes up for the dmg loss of not having ATK buff.

data.name: Moran
data.backstory: A Nikke from the Underworld Queen Squad, which managed the underworld of the Ark. Leads a small organization named Peony Organization. Values loyalty and camaraderie.
data.harmony_cubes_info: For more taunting outside Burst Skill, use Resilience. For higher HP, use Vigor. If you feel like she taunts too much outside Full Burst and want to dial it back a bit, try Bastion. However, this is not recommended! You can still use Resilience and manual her if you are worried.

data.name: N102
data.backstory: A Nikke from Recall & Release who is outgoing and energetic. Yet, she inexplicably feels a sense of emptiness inside herself.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube is the clear winner for her as she will reach Full Charge faster.

data.name: Naga
data.backstory: The spiritual glue that holds Dazzling Pearl together. She dotes on the forgetful Tia much like a older sister does to ensure that she remembers things. Appears mature on a regular basis, but if an accessory catches her eye, she often indulges in impulse purchases and overspending.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube or Bastion Cube will be the best options to use with Naga, as both promote Naga land more shots. Wingman Cube is also a decent alternative.

data.name: Neon
data.backstory: A rabid gun nut who thinks about nothing else. She is from Counters, but her true identity as a spy is an open secret.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Neon: Blue Ocean
data.backstory: Trapped on Blue Water Island and frustrated at the paucity of available Firepower, Neon dedicates herself to harnessing the power of Water.
data.harmony_cubes_info: MG goes brrr. Bastion Cube will allow her to shoot for longer, but if you don't have it upgraded, Resilience or Wingman Cubes are a better choice.

data.name: Nero
data.backstory: Attached to the Ark's animal management troop — Happy Zoo. She tends to all things pertaining to cats. Although soft-spoken, she is not in any way timid.
data.harmony_cubes_info: The Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase for a SMG user.

data.name: Neve
data.backstory: A Nikke subordinate to the Unlimited Squad. She is always searching for polar bears. Has a proclivity for hibernating, as she feels imitating the behavior of polar bears is the key to finding them.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Nihilister
data.backstory: A Heretic and loyal subject of the Rapture Queen who has long been a scourge to all Nikkes. As the lead general of the legions under the Queen’s command, her belligerence knows no bounds, nor does her appetite for destruction.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Either increasing the Mag Size or Reload Speed is the way to go for her.

data.name: Noah
data.backstory: A widely recognized invincible shield of the surface that protects Inherit. She has possessed tremendous strength since she was a child, leading to her picking up some bad habits.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube is the clear winner for her as she will reach Full Charge faster.

data.name: Noir
data.backstory: Biological elder sister of Light Bunny Blanc. Although they look different, Blanc pampers her constantly. While timid, she is not afraid to show her intentions.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion allows here to shoot the most ammo, but you can use Resilience cube if bastion doesn't have any more slots remaining.

data.name: Noise
data.backstory: She is a perfectionist pop star, as well as a songwriter who writes her own original material. Apart from being a member of Prima Donna, her hit song "Diva" catapulted her into stardom.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Healing Cube is the go-to cube for her currently.

data.name: Novel
data.backstory: A detective who is a fan of Sherlock Holmes. Her intense curiosity inevitably draws her towards any nearby crime scene. Although she is in Protocol, she has great difficulty operating machines.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion Cube will give her a higher uptime on her S2 buff while Resilience Cube will be a general improvement to her performance.

data.name: Pascal
data.harmony_cubes_info: Wingman or Resilience Cube are best on Pascal.

data.name: Pepper
data.backstory: A doctor who takes care of her patients with optimism. She is like a vitamin to Seraphim, and is admired by many as an idol of the hospital.
data.harmony_cubes_info: A Shotgun wielder with the last bullet mechanic really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: Phantom
data.harmony_cubes_info: Phantom has no special gimmicks. Resilience or Bastion fit her perfectly just fine. Bastion allows her to hit more bullets overall usually, but if Reload Speed buffers like Privaty or Crown are in the team, Resilience Cube is the better choice.

data.name: Phantom (Treasure)
data.backstory: During the day, she's a librarian at the Ark's biggest library. At night, she's a phantom thief who punishes evil in the name of justice. Though she believes she keeps her nightly activities well hidden, most of the people who should know of it already do.

data.name: Poli
data.backstory: Amember of the Ark police force and captain of the A.C.P.U. Squad. Her appearance and her temperament are lie that of a little puppy. Though she can be rather careless sometimes, she'sa real professional at work and always does a perfect job.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Poli (Treasure)
data.backstory: Amember of the Ark police force and captain of the A.C.P.U. Squad. Her appearance and her temperament are lie that of a little puppy. Though she can be rather careless sometimes, she'sa real professional at work and always does a perfect job.

data.name: Power
data.backstory: Member of Public Safety Devil Extermination Special Division 4. Blood devil fiend.
data.harmony_cubes_info: You really need Reload Speed on Power if you want to keep S1 buff stacks permanently.

data.name: Privaty
data.backstory: A girl who puts on a hard front, but in fact she enjoys taking care of others. At this juncture, she is the most highly skilled member of Triangle.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Last bullet mechanic with reload buff? Resilience all the way!

data.name: Privaty: Unkind Maid
data.backstory: After making a mess of the Maid Cafe, Privaty begins to work there as a temp to make up for the damages she caused.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Most of the time, you will want to use Bastion and reload before every Full Burst to guarantee no reload during the DPS window, in case Tove loses stacks immediately, and it's even better with 1 line Max Ammo Overload. But if you have enough reload speed (SAnis in team), you can use Resilience instead.

data.name: Product-08
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Series 8 models developed by Missilis.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Her S1 wants you to never fully charge your shots and just spam - this is why Reload Speed is important on her.

data.name: Product-12
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Series 12 models developed by Missilis.
data.harmony_cubes_info: MG goes brrr. Bastion Cube will allow her to shoot for longer, but if you don't have it upgraded, Resilience or Wingman Cubes are a better choice.

data.name: Product-23
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Series 23 models developed by Missilis.
data.harmony_cubes_info: A Shotgun wielder with the last bullet mechanic really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: Quency
data.backstory: A master escape artist who can break out of any prison where she is being kept captive. A highly amiable individual who excels in wheeling and dealing. She is always the life of the party at the Rehabilitation Center.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion Cube will give her a higher uptime on her S1 buff while Resilience Cube will be a general improvement to her performance.

data.name: Quency: Escape Queen
data.harmony_cubes_info: Depending on the comps used and OL, either Resilience or Bastion Level 7+ will be better in your situation. You might as well test both to see which one feels more comfortable and deals more damage. Resilience revolves around "reload as fast as possible to avoid losing stacks", whereas Bastion revolves around "avoid reloading so that you can shoot more shots with Stage 2 & 3 stacks".

data.name: Quiry
data.backstory: A member of A.C.P.U. She possesses exceptional administrative skills, but frequently runs into trouble due to her surprisingly poor eyesight.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Healing Cube is the go-to cube for her currently.

data.name: Ram
data.harmony_cubes_info: Ram doesn't really have anything in her kit that warrants the use of other than the generic damage increase cubes for an SR wielder.

data.name: Rapi
data.backstory: A troubled yet reliable girl who seeks to answer the question of just what Nikkes really are. As a member of Counters, she always ensures harmonious relations between various squadmates.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.

data.name: Rapi: Red Hood
data.backstory: Though Rapi once struggled with finding her own self-identity, the support of the Commander and her comrades helped her gain the confidence necessary to decide what path she must take.
data.harmony_cubes_info: In Reload Speed comps (with Crown), Resilience is the better choice. Make sure to reload before entering Full Burst to ensure 10s of continuous shooting. Note that Crown's reload buff lingers for 5s after ending Full Burst. Otherwise, Bastion is likely the better choice but make sure to do some testing to see which works best for your team, rotation, and investments.

data.name: Rapunzel
data.backstory: A saint-like figure who appeases the spirits of those who have died on the surface. Often found lost in prayer, she is also prone to reminiscence.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Healing Cube is the go-to cube for her currently.

data.name: Raven
data.harmony_cubes_info: She does not require any specific cubes to work. If you are confused, just use Resilience cube, especially if Raven is being used with allies who can buff reload speed. There is another merit to this, and that is helping Raven maintain 10 DoT stacks even after reloads. You don't need it, but it gives more leeway.

data.name: Red Hood B3
data.backstory: The last Grimms Model joining the Goddess squad. She's a bold and cheerful Nikke who loves old songs. Her red hair, red scarf, and red jacket are quite unforgettable.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Red doesn't actually need any cube, so a generic DPS cube like Bastion/Resilience is okay. You can actually put Adjutant if it's the same level as your highest lvl cube to increase her overall DPS by a small margin! Or using Vigor (Hp) Cube to manipulate Blanc's Indomitable in PVP too.

data.name: Rei
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Rei Ayanami
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion has the edge over Resilience on MGs. But, if you pair Rei with Reload Speed buffers like Crown or Privaty, then Resilience works just fine. As long as her reload is shorter than 0.6s (76% reload), she will not have to wind up.

data.name: Rei Ayanami (Tentative Name)
data.harmony_cubes_info: As is common, Resilience cube for reload teams (Crown, Maid Anchor and Maid Mast, Privaty), otherwise use Bastion cube. Destruction cube is the best choice in teams like Crown-Priv or Maid Duo team since reload speed is already so high that we can ignore it. Instead, using Destruction cube to increase damage dealt to parts from her base weapon should be the best way to increase her damage.

data.name: Rem
data.backstory: The younger of the twin maids who works at Roswaal Mansion.
data.harmony_cubes_info:
• Bastion - The universal choice for all MGs as it offers the highest uptime extension without external help.

  • Resilience - If paired with reload speed buffers like Privaty, Resilience (with some Max Ammo) may reduce downtime to the point that it is unfelt.

data.name: Rosanna
data.backstory: Leader of Hedonia, a sizable criminal gang. Compared with other members of the Underworld Queen, she is far more pugnacious and firmly believes that violence is the ultimate panacea. She does, however, take exceedingly good care of those who are part of her gang.
data.harmony_cubes_info: MG goes brrr. Bastion Cube will allow her to shoot for longer, but if you don't have it upgraded, Resilience or Wingman Cubes are a better choice.

data.name: Rosanna (Treasure)
data.backstory: Leader of Hedonia, a sizable criminal gang. Compared with other members of the Underworld Queen, she is far more pugnacious and firmly believes that violence is the ultimate panacea. She does, however, take exceedingly good care of those who are part of her gang.

data.name: Rosanna: Chic Ocean
data.harmony_cubes_info: Rosanna does not particularly require any cube. Any generic cube works on her, but Bastion will allow her to shoot more bullets over 3 minutes. Despite that, it is recommended to use the highest level cube available for the base stat bonuses to help with her caster's ATK buff.

data.name: Rouge
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the ideal cube for Rouge if she has 1× Max Ammo OL. This will make the triggering of her CDR much smoother. Otherwise, without Max Ammo OL, Wingman Cube Level 7+ is the next best alternative to get her Ammo to 8 to match the number requirement of Skill 1.

data.name: Rumani
data.backstory: Rumani is a member of the Nepenthe squad. She is well-educated, with a deep understanding of muscles, bones, and all aspects of the human body. When it comes to exercises, she knows exactly how to maximize the results.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Quantum Cube can effectively be used in some teams with Rumani due to her high Burst Generation. However, other PvP cubes like Tempering Cube, Vigor Cube, or Adjutant Cube may also be used to high effect.

data.name: Rupee
data.backstory: A bombastic shopaholic. She conducts various live streams where she shares her joy of shopping with others. She is Talentim's hottest star.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Pre-overload you want to either increase Rupee mag size above 100 so she can trigger her S1 without reloading. If this isn't possible, just use the Resilience Cube on her so she reloads faster. Post-overload Bastion Cube overcomes both of the Cubes though.

data.name: Rupee: Winter Shopper
data.backstory: Rupee dressed up in a Santa Claus costume, which she has done to deliver gifts and spread the Christmas cheer to everyone this winter. The first white Christmas in 15 years has Rupee incredible busy.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the best choice for anyone with the last bullet mechanism.

data.name: Sakura
data.backstory: A Nikke belonging to Underworld Queen who is also the head of a yakuza group known as the Seimeikai. A woman of principle, the Seimeikai refrain from engaging in immoral acts thanks to her leadership. Under her guidance, the Seimeikai has become an organization with a well-deserved reputation for its honorable conduct.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Either increasing Sakura's Mag Size or increasing her Reload Speed is the way to go for her - you really want to stack the S1 buff as fast as possible.

data.name: Sakura: Bloom in Summer
data.harmony_cubes_info: S. Sakura does not particularly require any cube. Any generic cube works on her, but Bastion will allow her to shoot more bullets over 3 minutes. Despite that, it is recommended to use the highest level cube available for the ATK (and Elemental DMG) bonus.

data.name: Scarlet
data.backstory: A wandering swordswoman from Pioneer who's partial to a good drink. Despite the common perception of melee weapons being ineffective in combat, she chooses to wield a sword.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the go-to choice for Scarlet pre-overload gear and when your Bastion Cube is still not upgraded to level 7. Post-overload though, Bastion Cube scales way better than Resilience because you can get Max Ammo as overload perk.

data.name: Scarlet: Black Shadow
data.backstory: The former look of Scarlet. She and her sister Rose were Melee Squad members who tested close-quarters combat versus Raptures.
data.harmony_cubes_info: The most economical option is Bastion. While Onslaught is theoretically the best cube for SBS when it comes to pure damage, it is very niché and does not pair well with most other units. Thus, you will be better off using Bastion for the increased stats and elemental damage bonus. Besides that, when coupled with Alice, SBS will shoot faster. In order for her to last until the next Full Burst without reloading even once, you usually need to rely on Bastion (and 1 or more Max Ammo OL lines). This should result in more damage provided versus Onslaught. Regardless, you may benefit from Adjutant more if you have a low charge speed roll and want to reach a certain breakpoint (as stated in Gear Investment). Note that the case above doesn't convert well for PvP as there she is bound to reload before entering Full Burst if she doesn't have Max Ammo OL, in which case Resilience is a better option than Bastion. Since she gains Max Ammo from Skill 2 (and reloads fully just as Full Burst begins), it is unnecessary to equip Bastion to make full use of her devastating Burst Skill. Bastion would only be a good choice if Alice were also in the team, but that's usually questionable in PvP to bring a low-regen Nikke just to boost damage slightly.

data.name: Signal
data.backstory: A communicator for the Scouts and also the best in her field. As a massive fan of soap operas, she always harbors fantasies about torrid love affairs.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Bastion Cube will give her a higher uptime on her S1 debuff while Resilience Cube will be a general improvement to her performance.

data.name: Sin
data.backstory: The leader of the Real Kindness Squad. She can brainwash others using words alone. This ability, in combination with some additional verbal gymnastics, makes her able to turn anyone into a mindless puppet.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube is the best choice for anyone with the last bullet mechanism.

data.name: Siren
data.harmony_cubes_info: When Elemental Advantage is concerned, use the highest level cube available. Otherwise, Bastion or Resilience (with Reload Speed comps) would suit her well, but in the end it does not matter much because her auto-attack damage is negligible.

data.name: Snow White
data.backstory: A puritanical pilgrim who wanders the surface in an effort to protect humanity. As a member of Pioneer, her days are spent wiping out Raptures with extreme prejudice.
data.harmony_cubes_info: If you're using SW one-shot team then you can equip Onslaught Cube on her, but in any other scenario, you're better with Resilience/Bastion/Wingman. Adjutant Cube is also an option to squeeze in the 5s damage window.

data.name: Snow White: Innocent Days
data.backstory: How Snow White from Pioneer used to look like. Kind, always thinks of her teammates, and is very close to Red Hood.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.

data.name: Soda
data.harmony_cubes_info: MG goes brrr. Bastion Cube will allow her to shoot for longer, but if you don't have it upgraded, Resilience or Wingman Cubes are a better choice.

data.name: Soda: Twinkling Bunny
data.backstory: In order to participate in the Tetra Golden Chip event, Soda ends up donning a bunny outfit. Unsure if the outfit will bring her good luck, she will nonetheless do her best for Maid For You.
data.harmony_cubes_info:
Due to the extra reloading animation imposed on B. Soda, we want to avoid reloading as much as possible.

  • Bastion remains the best cube and is miles better than the other options.

  • Resilience is second best. No questions asked.

  • Technically, you can also use Quantum for PvP (if that extra juice is needed).

data.name: Soldier EG
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Elysion, collectively known as Model EG.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience Cube helps with the long reload Soldier EG has.

data.name: Soldier FA
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Elysion, collectively known as Model FA.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Soldier OW
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Elysion, collectively known as Model OW.
data.harmony_cubes_info: A SMG wielder with a long reload time really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: Soline
data.backstory: An attendant of Infinity Rail that's responsible for attracting customers. She always wants to be more adult-like in order to appear more competent. Though she may seem sure of herself all the time, the truth is, she's just a braggart who often fails to live up to her words.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Sora
data.harmony_cubes_info:
Sora's technically a healer in PvP and more of a regular semi-healer-semi-offense support unit in PvE. This makes her cube recommendations different for both game modes.

For PvE, Resilience, Bastion, or any of your higher-leveled cubes is good enough. This will give her more ATK stat. Resilience/Bastion may help with burst genning too because they allow her to shoot more. If more healing is needed, then Vigor/Healing will serve the job.

In PvP, if she is tanking in P1, Tempering is probably the best cube. Vigor/Healing will boost her healing power, making her Burst more impactful. However, Healing does not directly increase her tankiness.

data.name: Sugar
data.backstory: A gearhead, who gets a thrill from burning rubber, sells sugar coffee in Cafe Sweety.
data.harmony_cubes_info: You want to shoot as many as you can during her AS buff, then Bastion/Resi in here will be better. But if you don't have enough space and are lazy to swap cube around, a Wingman is okay

data.name: Sugar (Treasure)
data.backstory: A gearhead, who gets a thrill from burning rubber, sells sugar coffee in Cafe Sweety.

data.name: Tia
data.backstory: A Nikke belonging to the graduating class, Dazzling Pearl squad. A food enthusiast who's fond of sweets. Her dream is to see a dragon one day and make a wish to it.
data.harmony_cubes_info: You can use Resilience/Bastion for CP padding in campaign, although Tia has a mechanic relied on attack, you actually don't want it to trigger more often. Either she will die, or your cover die. In both cases, you are pretty much guaranteed a retry. Just make sure she stays alive with Vigor.

data.name: Tove
data.backstory: A Nikke acting as a new mechanic in Unlimited, which is the squad with an only drawback of continuous malfunctioning equipments. She boasts a plethora of theoretical knowledge, but lacks practical experience, which invariably leads to various mishaps. However, as an out-and-out extrovert, she is slowly but successfully fitting into the squad.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Base Tove (no Max Ammo) reloads every 6s. This means she will be hitting minimum probability in almost every 5s window. Because of this, we recommend Resilience, but Bastion 7+ is also not a bad pick as it will make accruing 3 stacks within 1 clip easier. If she has high base ammo, you should get Bastion instead, as maintaining stacks is much easier if Tove keeps firing. It also synergizes well with her Emergency Bullet (Skill 1)

data.name: Trina
data.harmony_cubes_info: For PvE, use your highest level cube or Resilience/Bastion to make spamming for burst gen with her easier. But, for PvP min-maxing, Healing/Vigor Cube is the most optimal, because she’s a healer. If you put her in S2, she may be killed by wild Laplace (due to ELE advantage), so Tempering can make do, too.

data.name: Trony
data.backstory: A Nikke from the Electric Shock squad. She's the pioneer of the electrical engineering field. Due to her lack of social skills, it's difficult for her to communicate with other Nikkes.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience or Bastion would do fine. We recommend Bastion Lv 7+ if you have exactly 1x Max Ammo, as the extra 3 shots will help with charging Burst Energy after Full Burst(s). Otherwise, we prefer Resilience because their uptime/downtime balance is more consistent, especially if you're running her with other Reload buffers like Crown or Privaty.

data.name: Vesti
data.backstory: A timid girl who is a crybaby. Despite this, she is actually said to be Absolute's strongest ace member.
data.harmony_cubes_info: All three Cubes work really well on her and what you use is up to you.

data.name: Vesti: Tactical Upgrade
data.backstory:
As the primary offensive member of Absolute — Elysion's most elite squad — she is well-known for raining hellfire upon any enemy, in any situation.

Although Vesti is typically shy and timid by nature, she becomes excitable beyond all measure when unleashing a fusillade of her full arsenal in battle

data.name: Viper
data.backstory: The staff officer of the Exotic Squad. She can manipulate any human with her verbal trickery and physical beauty.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Viper (Treasure)
data.backstory: The staff officer of the Exotic Squad. She can manipulate any human with her verbal trickery and physical beauty.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps Shotgun wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Volume
data.backstory: A hip-hop singer from Prima Donna who constantly finds herself becoming a hot topic among the public. Her trademarks are her flamboyant outfits and a demeanor that’s rough-around-the-edges.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Assault Cube helps SMG wielders to actually hit something past Near range. While the Resilience Cube is a generic DPS increase (but it's better in scenarios when you fight stuff only in Near range as there Hit Rate isn't that useful).

data.name: Yan
data.backstory: An experienced merchant with a knack for striking deals. She uses her business acumen to operate several large-scale supermarket chains. Talentum's rise to fame can all be traced back to her.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube is the clear winner for her as she will reach Full Charge faster.

data.name: Yulha
data.backstory: An office worker that suffers from work overload. She is the leader of Triangle, and a reliable leader at that. Others inexplicably refer to her as Ghost.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Onslaught and Resilience Cube both work really well on Yulha, while Wingman is trailing behind them, but still being a viable option.

data.name: Yuni
data.backstory: A sadistic girl from Wardress. She can control others' senses, and she communicates by inflicting pain upon others.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Adjutant Cube is the clear winner for her as she will reach Full Charge faster.

data.name: Zwei
data.harmony_cubes_info: Any cube works on Zwei. Zwei is not a good damage dealer herself, but to maximise the number of bullets shot, the best cubes are either Bastion or Resilience Cubes.

data.name: frima
data.backstory: The leader of Cafe Sweety, who sells cream coffee. Her inherent laziness actually leads her to discover the most efficient ways to get things done.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Charge Speed increase helps with both S1 and S2.

data.name: iDoll Flower
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Tetra, collectively known as Flower.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Reload Speed is best choice for characters that use the last bullet mechanics.

data.name: iDoll Ocean
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Tetra, collectively known as Ocean.
data.harmony_cubes_info: A SMG wielder with the last bullet mechanic really needs the Resilience Cube.

data.name: iDoll Sun
data.backstory: A Nikke from Replace. One of mass-produced Nikke models developed by Tetra, collectively known as Sun.
data.harmony_cubes_info: Resilience and Bastion Cubes work best on most AR wielders and she isn't an exception.
